rules.notes: 0.05% on the sell side only. Statutory; never part of a GST base. Law: Finance (No. 2) Act, 2004 s.98 Table serial 4, entry (c), sale of a futures in securities: "0.05 per cent." (Finance Act, 2026 s.159(iii)). The new rate applies from 30-3-2026: Finance Act, 2026 s.159 states no date and is not among the sections s.1(2) brings in on 1-4-2026, so by the General Clauses Act, 1897 s.5(1)(b) it came into operation on the President's assent, 30-3-2026. The brokers' pages print "from 1 Apr 2026" (docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 12). Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 10 and row 12.

SEBI turnover fee on equity derivatives, Rs 10 per crore of turnover. Law: SEBI (Payment of Fees) (Amendment) Regulations, 2019 (equity derivatives 0.00010 per cent), carried into the SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations, 2026. Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 14.

0.002% on the buy side only. Statutory; never part of a GST base. Law: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Schedule I Article 56A(d)(i), futures (equity and commodity): 0.002% (Finance Act 2019, in force 1-7-2020). Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 13.

18% on the taxable services. The base is listed explicitly; securities transaction tax and stamp duty are absent by design (D1). Law: CGST 9% + SGST 9%, or IGST 18%: heading 9971, financial and related services not elsewhere listed (Notification 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) Sl. 15; 8/2017-Integrated Tax (Rate)). Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 8.
